arxiv-2111-06831.creator: Turkuler Durgut, Hari K. Kunduri
arxiv-2111-06831.description: Abstract We construct supersymmetric, asymptotically AdS 5 gravitational soliton solutions of five-dimensional gauged supergravity coupled to arbitrarily many vector multiplets. These generalize the supersymmetric solitons of U ​ ( 1 ) 3 U(1)^{3} gauged supergravity previously obtained by Chong, Cvetic, and Pope as limits of local, non-supersymmetric metrics.

arxiv-2504-04800.title: Spin bond order driven by extended repulsive interactions in doped graphene
arxiv-2504-04800.creator: Jin-Ju Ri, Song-Jin O, Chol-Su O
arxiv-2504-04800.description: Abstract We use the truncated-unity functional renormalization group (TUFRG) to study many-body instabilities of correlated electrons in graphene doped near the van Hove singularity (VHS). The system is described by an extended Hubbard model including several Coulomb repulsions between neighboring sites.

arxiv-2511-01650.title: EngChain : A Symbolic Benchmark for Verifiable Multi-Step Reasoning in Engineering
arxiv-2511-01650.creator: Ayesha Gull Muhammad Usman Safder Rania Elbadry, Preslav Nakov Zhuohan Xie
arxiv-2511-01650.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being applied to specialized, high-stakes domains like engineering, which demands rigorous evaluation of their complex reasoning capabilities. While current benchmarks assess language understanding, factual recall, mathematics or code generation, none capture the integrative reasoning central to engineering where scientific principles, quantitative modeling and practical constraints must converge.

pmc-10692729.title: Vertebral artery dissection in relation to pregnancy: a case series and literature review
pmc-10692729.creator: Kendal F Rosalik, Logan M Havemann, Morgan E Wasickanin, Jill A McCaulley, Sarah M Edwards, Katherine M Leonard
pmc-10692729.description: Cervical artery dissection is an uncommon condition for which pregnancy and postpartum states confer increased risk. Although the majority of patients with this condition fully recover, including resolution of the dissection on imaging, long-term sequelae include a variety of cardiovascular conditions that may be associated with high rates of morbidity and mortality.

pmc-11508663.title: Preoperative Embolization in the Management of Giant Thoracic Tumors: A Case Series
pmc-11508663.creator: Nicola Maria Lucarelli, Nicola Maggialetti, Giuseppe Marulli, Pierluigi Mariani, Ilaria Villanova, Alessandra Mirabile, Chiara Morelli, Angela De Palma, Amato Antonio Stabile Ianora, László Mangel
pmc-11508663.description: Objectives: The aim of this paper is to describe our experience in the embolization of hypervascular giant thoracic tumors before surgical excision. Methods: A single-center retrospective review of five trans-arterial preoperative embolization procedures executed between October 2020 and July 2024. Patients’ demographics, anatomical aspects, feasibility, technique, and outcomes were reviewed.

pmc-12448788.title: Effective management of pregnancy- and lactation-associated osteoporosis using romosozumab: a clinical case report
pmc-12448788.creator: Atsushi Goshima, Hideki Tsuboi, Takashi Kaito, Motoki Iwasaki
pmc-12448788.description: Pregnancy- and lactation-related osteoporosis (PLO) is a rare condition characterized by reduced bone density and increased fracture risk during late pregnancy or early postpartum. Because of its rarity, no well-established treatment exists for PLO. Here, we report a case demonstrating significant improvements in bone density and the absence of new fractures after 12 mo of romosozumab (ROMO) treatment following weaning.

pmc-12566798.title: Minute Rebond: A Simple Method for Making Lab-Scale Rebonded Foam and Its Application as a Novel Soilless Growing Media
pmc-12566798.creator: Michael S. Harris, Harry Charles Wright, Tom Lilly, Nathan Seithel, Chris Hayes, Julie Walker, Jacob Nickles, Duncan Drummond Cameron, Anthony John Ryan
pmc-12566798.description: Polyurethane foams (PUFs) utilised in the comfort industry generate substantial trim waste volumes requiring end-of-life management. Rebonding, one form of mechanical recycling, is a technique involving the mechanical breakdown and subsequent adhesion of PUF using polyurethane prepolymers yielding a recycled material.

pmc-12629329.title: 2′-Fucosyllactose supplementation results in a transient improvement in gut microbial resilience after vancomycin use in adults with overweight or obesity: a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled intervention
pmc-12629329.creator: Lars MM Vliex, David Barnett, Elena Monzel, Arjen Nauta, Guy J Oudhuis, Marina Fassarella, Jens J Holst, Erwin G Zoetendal, John Penders, Ellen E Blaak
pmc-12629329.description: Antibiotic-induced perturbations of the gut microbiome can be long-lasting and potentially affect host metabolic health. Strategies supporting microbial resilience are needed to mitigate the negative impact of antibiotics. We investigated the potential of 2′-fucosyllactose (2′-FL) supplementation after vancomycin use in a double-blind placebo-controlled randomized intervention among adults with overweight/obesity.

pmc-13250827.title: Infant traumatic brain injury with a biphasic clinical course and late diffusion restriction: a case report
pmc-13250827.creator: Dong He, Rong Yan, Peng Zhang, Xiang Yue, Shunwu Xiao
pmc-13250827.description: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) in young children can rarely exhibit a biphasic clinical course with delayed neurological deterioration. We report a 2-year-old boy who fell from 50 cm and briefly lost consciousness with vomiting, initially found to have a right frontotemporoparietal acute subdural hematoma (SDH) with midline shift but no brain contusions.
